name: Shakshuka
description: Eggs gently poached in a smoky pepper and tomato sauce, made in one pan. Bring plenty of bread for mopping up.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat the oil in a large frying pan and cook the onion and pepper over a medium heat for 10 minutes until soft.
Stir in the garlic, cumin and paprika and cook for 1 minute, then add the tomatoes and simmer for 8–10 minutes until thickened. Season to taste.
Make four hollows in the sauce, crack an egg into each, cover with a lid and cook for 5–6 minutes until the whites are set but the yolks still runny.
Scatter with coriander and serve straight from the pan with bread.
